result: Managed verification passed: 94 tests, Release build, frontend build, bounded cleanup, compatibility revalidation, and Docker preview determinism. Final acceptance remains blocked because runtime host validation accepts only minimal MZ/ELF magic instead of a valid host x64 PE/ELF header, and the Linux opt-in import/export test directly invokes the service rather than authenticated HTTP routes. Native environment variables are absent on this Windows host, so guarded native route execution was not run.

evidence.ref: dotnet test FactorioServerManager.sln --configuration Release --no-restore; dotnet build FactorioServerManager.sln --configuration Release --no-restore
evidence.outcome: Passed 94/94 tests; Release build succeeded with 0 warnings/errors.
Frontend production build passed with only existing SignalR annotation warnings.
Bounded cleanup, compatibility snapshots/revalidation, auth/stopped/ActiveSave/atomic gates, and service-level round-trip path are present.
Nauvis and Vulcanus deterministic PNG hashes were independently repeated successfully.
MZ and ELF magic-only validation can classify corrupt or wrong-architecture files as ready; valid x64 PE/ELF header parsing is still required.
Opt-in Linux import/export test exercises NativeMapExchangeService directly; it does not bind HTTP authentication/CSRF/audit routes. Route group configuration itself inherits those filters.

next_slice.summary: Parse valid host x64 PE/ELF headers, add route-boundary coverage without external dependencies, then rerun final QA; native route execution remains opt-in on Linux.

blockers: Minimal executable magic validation does not prove valid host x64 PE/ELF.
Linux opt-in import/export test bypasses HTTP route binding; native environment variables are absent on Windows host.
